task_commits.subject: feat(evaluation): freeze dynamic pool evaluation splits

properties: all non-geographic identity fields are mandatory
no_geo is explicit and never becomes a shared synthetic identity
identity links are unioned transitively before assignment
item, component and complete-register semantics are fingerprinted
labels are decisive source-bound human-supported booleans
whole independence components enter exactly one partition
supported and error outcome coverage is reserved for every partition
configured weights, seed, component register and assignment are fingerprinted
validation recomputes the deterministic assignment and rejects manual movement
a class with fewer than three independent components fails closed

post_push_balance_correction.finding: the first 18-component fixture remained leakage-safe and outcome-complete but allocated item counts 2/8/8 under 40/30/30 weights
post_push_balance_correction.cause: the greedy balance score minimized absolute residual after assignment rather than projected fill relative to each split target
post_push_balance_correction.regression_rule: each independent-unit count differs from its configured target by at most one

first_party_basis: Phase 9 source-bound review and grouping contracts

allowed: Task 10.1 prevents known Flickr photo, owner, duplicate, observation, real-geography and source-mirror identities crossing frozen evaluation partitions.
The deterministic fixture gives every partition supported and error evidence while respecting 40/30/30 weights within one atomic component.
The post-push allocation imbalance was detected, preserved in history and corrected with a regression test.
blocked: The fixture proves live reviewed evidence is sufficient for calibration or final evaluation.
Unknown or unavailable identities cannot cause residual leakage.
A frozen split is a fitted calibrator, selected threshold or statistical support result.
Final-test partition membership authorizes release or publication.
